scope: Table 2 row A: all 16 four-variable configurations; reproduction on the existing repository log-fitness transcription. Raw experimental source conversion is not re-certified by this test.
preprocessing: Retain every input row with equal weight; no missing-state imputation, subsampling, uncertainty adjustment or RNG. Fit intercept plus 0/1 predictors by OLS; r is residual RMSE (divide by N); s is mean absolute non-intercept coefficient. Graph edges and optimization direction do not affect the statistic. Chou2011.csv fitness is already on the log-relative scale; do not log again.
